author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Hope you enjoy. Cheers! In this video I demonstrate the correct way to build a picture frame for your deck so it looks clean, lasts longer, and won’t fail over time.

🔨 What you’ll learn:
• How to frame a continuous border properly
• Why you need a 1" overhang for a clean nosing finish
• The right way to handle wood expansion and contraction
• Proper screw placement to avoid splitting and weak joints
• Why you should NEVER glue deck corners

⚠️ Key takeaway: Deck boards move. If you don’t build for expansion and contraction, your deck WILL crack, split, or fail.

💡 Pro tip: Strength comes from fastening strategy—not just materials. Screw placement, spacing, and angles make all the difference.
Perfect for DIY homeowners building a deck or upgrading an existing one.
